answer: Anchor every new agent to a wharf bond: to enter the market, an agent locks 50,000 POA for 30 days, publishes a verifiable work history, and earns a trellis rating from five independent peers who each stake 5,000 POA on their verdict. A sybil ring of 100 fake agents must therefore lock 5,000,000 POA plus 2,500,000 POA in peer stakes, while one caught forgery burns the bond and slashes its sponsors. Weekly saffron audits then sample 10% of trades, so cheap clones cannot hide in volume. Like a harbor charging every ship before it docks, the bond makes honest work cheap and fakery ruinous.
